critical_steps: The proof yields (1+mu) times the q-energy square root at least (1-lambda) times the p-energy square root.
For lambda=mu=t and q-scaling r=(1-t)/(1+t), the source hypothesis holds with equality on every subset containing the active index.
The printed lower bound equals 1 while the q-only weave has exact lower bound r squared.
The corrected lower bound equals r squared and is exact on this family.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct reconstruction of the theorem's triangle-inequality step plus an exact one-parameter counterexample in the standard two-inner-product model.
integrity.unproved_limits: No necessity theorem or classification of all geometry-dependent sharper bounds is asserted.
